text: {"lessons":["Frequent account checks and monthly price moves are not enough evidence to justify a trade; I should make decisions from a researched plan and longer-term goals.","Selling after sharp declines in Stock E and Stock C did not by itself show whether the decision was sound; I should reassess each holding’s prospects and apply consistent sell criteria rather than react to losses.","My account value changed only modestly over these periods, so I should judge progress against my ten-year apartment goal and keep a diversified, disciplined approach instead of chasing quick gains."]}
